role: Transient top-of-screen toast: banner view, payload type, a ViewModifier that overlays it, announces it to VoiceOver and auto-clears it after 2.5 s, and a .toastBanner(_:) View extension. Only caller: DashboardV2View.
types: ToastBanner: struct (View) — capsule with glyph + message
ToastPayload: struct (Equatable, Identifiable) — glyph/message/tint with a fresh UUID id
toplevel: ToastPayload.id = UUID() initialised per instance; tint defaults to AppTheme.wongOptimal. Doc says slide in 250ms/hold 2.5s/slide out 200ms; code matches (0.25 easeOut insertion, 2.5 s sleep, 0.2 easeOut removal).

units.does: Renders glyph (scaled 14pt, tint) and message (scaled 13pt, textPrimary) in a capsule filled with AdaptiveMaterial.ultraThin (opaque under Reduce Transparency), shadowed, combined into one accessibility element labelled with the message.
Equality compares only the UUID id, so two toasts with identical text are distinct.
units.entry: Equatable conformance used by SwiftUI value comparison

units.does: Overlays the banner at the top of content and animates changes keyed on toast?.id with 0.25 s easeOut.

flags.text: Toast insert/remove animations (.easeOut 0.25 and withAnimation .easeOut 0.2) ignore Reduce Motion, contrary to the policy in Animation+ReduceMotion that interactive transitions must consult it.

units.does: When toast is non-nil, shows ToastBanner padded 16pt from top with move+opacity insertion / opacity removal and a .task(id: toast.id) that runs announceThenDismiss.
units.entry: SwiftUI view builder; .task(id:) starts/cancels per toast id

branches.effect: render banner and start its task; nil → empty

flags.text: Header says the toast slides out over 200 ms; the removal transition is .opacity only, no slide.

units.does: Posts a VoiceOver announcement with the message, sleeps 2.5 s (cancellation swallowed by sleepQuietly), then if the task wasn't cancelled and the binding still holds the same toast id, sets toast to nil with 0.2 s easeOut.

branches.effect: clear toast; cancelled or replaced by a newer toast → return without clearing

units.does: Applies ToastBannerModifier with the given binding.
